This gives me a musician's sense of design balance and executive-level client communication.

## Verified Production Client Projects
1. **Om Sai Jewellers** (https://omsaijewellersbgm.netlify.app)
   - **Category**: Luxury Jewellery & Retail
   - **Summary**: Built a luxury digital storefront for Belagavi’s renowned jewellery showroom in Shahapur. Engineered with real-time hourly bullion market rates (24K Gold, 22K Gold, 925 Pure Silver) via StockeZee, an interactive metal price calculator, collection lookbooks, and instant WhatsApp inquiry pipelines.
   - **Stack**: HTML5 / Modern JS, CSS Grid, Live Rates API, WhatsApp API, Netlify

2. **Shri Kamakshi Clinic & Orthopaedic Centre** (https://shrikamakshiclinic.netlify.app)
   - **Category**: Healthcare & Orthopaedics
   - **Summary**: Designed and engineered a high-converting, mobile-first web platform for a dual-specialty medical clinic in Belagavi. The platform bridges family medicine and advanced orthopaedic manual rehabilitation with clear doctor profiles, direct appointment calling, and verified patient reviews.
   - **Stack**: HTML5, Modern CSS, Responsive UI, Schema.org SEO, Netlify

3. **Om Sai Gold** (https://omsaigold.ai.studio)
   - **Category**: Bullion & Live rates
   - **Summary**: A mobile responsive webapp built for a renowned bullion business to display daily gold and silver bullion rates to their customers and merchants.The client needed a digital storefront to efficiently communicate daily fluctuating gold and silver prices, reducing the need for customers to call or visit the store just to check rates.
   - **Stack**: HTML5, Modern CSS, Responsive UI, Java Script
